text:
alex: Hey folks — opened a runtime PR that touches batching, KV cache eviction, and a small-sequence attention kernel tweak. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823

alex: Short summary: switch batching window policy to adaptive-shape (should shave ~25-35ms off p99 on our web traces), change KV cache eviction to TTL-based (default 1h), and add a tiled attention path for seq_len <= 64. Tests pass locally but nightly CI had one flaky e2e. Planning to merge during tomorrow's merge window (10:00 PDT) unless there are objections. PTAL? @tara @sam :eyes:

tara: Can you paste the perf numbers/artifacts? I want clear 64 vs 512 comparisons and the microbench command you ran.

alex: Perf summary (from local runs on a p4d-like instance):
- 64 tokens: median latency -8.2ms, p99 -31ms
- 512 tokens: median +1.1ms, p99 +2.8ms
- Microbench command: `bazel run //tools/perf:throughput -- --model=gpt-small --seq=64,512 --iters=100`
- Artifact: `s3://redwood-artifacts/perf/4823/2026-03-16-summary.json`

sam: Thanks. Quick question — do we have a feature flag or canary plan for the kernel path? I'd prefer to gate the small-seq kernel for a gradual rollout.

alex: Good call. Added `--feature-flag=opt_small_seq_kernel` (default: on for canary, off for global). Also added rollout notes + health checks in the PR description.

leo: CI shows `nightly-k8s-e2e` failed earlier — looks like OOM in batcher integration test. @ci-bot any details?

ci-bot: Job 9456 `nightly-k8s-e2e` failed: `batcher_integration_test` OOM on node pool `small-ci`. Logs: https://ci.redwood-infra/builds/9456/log

tara: OOM probably due to new batching window sizing on small instances. For canary, we should reduce `max_batch_size` to 32 (was 64) and lower `batch_window_ms` for small nodes.

alex: Will update canary config: `max_batch_size=32`, `batch_window_ms=12` for small nodes. Also lowering KV TTL to `1h` (was 6h) to bound memory.

sam: SGTM. I'll take the kernel tiling review now — give me ~3 hours.

tara: I can watch the canary rollout and approve after CI green and perf dashboards look good. +1 to the flag approach.

alex: Re-running CI with updated config now: `./scripts/ci/retry.sh 9456` — ping here when green.

ci-bot: Rerun started for job 9456.

ci-bot: Job 9456 completed: all tests passed except flaky `metrics_collector_test` (marked flaky, not blocking). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood-infra/builds/9456/artifacts

sam: Reviewed kernel tiling change, left two minor comments about vector alignment (non-blocking). Overall LGTM.

tara: Verified perf dashboards for canary (us-west2) over 30m: p99 improved ~28ms for web-traces, no spike in error-rate. Approving.

alex: Thanks all — merging now. Will roll to canary in us-west2 first. Watch dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/d/serving/runtime-batcher-kv

alex: If anything looks off, rollback by setting `--feature-flag=opt_small_seq_kernel=false` or revert canary config `max_batch_size=64`.

alex: Merged in 4823. Rolling to canary; leaving follow-up todo to add a brief note to the runbook about the KV TTL change. :thumbsup!
